digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation validity and pin-health enforcement
propositions: Introduce an optional opt-in config key that, when enabled, uses signed plan-material pins as the single validity check so pin drift, malformed pins, or missing targets invalidate the attestation; when disabled the same observations are advisory and validity is unchanged.

Legacy wholly-unpinned attestations and pre-feature sidecars remain valid in either enforcement mode, and the reading of the optional enforcement config fails open (returns false with a structured warning) rather than raising.

Add a derived DerivedPlanReviewHealth contract with fixed pin_status severity aggregation returned alongside existing validity results for plan-review, computed after signature/kind verification but before other early returns, while completion-verifier results retain their existing three-key shape.

Extend compute_validity with a plan-review-only PlanValidityProfile (DEFAULT/CLOSE/DRIFT_REFRESH) where CLOSE and DRIFT_REFRESH disable only code freshness while retaining signature/registry/own-material/pin checks.

Refactor drift_refresh_candidate to delegate signature/kind/reopen/registry/own-material/pin validity to compute_validity(DRIFT_REFRESH) and retain only inline dependency-hash drift qualification, with reopened attestations disqualified from refresh.

Thread the pre-LLM reviewed related-material snapshot through sidecar.emit/build_payload so failed-sign recovery via resign_plan_review can validate pins without a certified attestation, enforcing or advising based on the toggle.
